name: STAG1 cohesin complex component

function.text: STAG1 encodes cohesin subunit SA-1. Annotated molecular activities include chromatin binding. It participates in mitotic spindle assembly and sister chromatid cohesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 47 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
